rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account states that on 5 April 2000 森総理, designated that afternoon by agreeing votes of both Houses, was appointed at the Imperial appointment ceremony (親任式) at the Palace that night as the 85th Prime Minister (55th person) since Itō Hirobumi (同日夜、宮中での親任式において…内閣総理大臣に任命された).

locator.section: caption paragraph beginning 平成12年4月5日、森喜朗（もり よしろう）内閣が発足

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same page, headed 森喜朗内閣発足, states that the Mori cabinet was launched on 5 April 2000 and that after the attestation ceremony 森総理 issued appointments to his ministers, held the first cabinet meeting and a press conference, calling 6 April his second day in office.

locator.section: same paragraph and the 4月6日 caption
